title: Finding
description: A single performance finding emitted by one of the worker stages (static, bundle, reassure, device_android, device_ios, tooling). The verdict and verification_method fields are internal scaffolding consumed by Pass A; they MUST NOT appear in the final report.

id.description: Stable rule ID, dot-separated: <layer>.<rule_name> or <layer>.<namespace>.<rule_name>. Examples: 'static.scrollview_with_long_list', 'bundle.dependency_oversize', 'store.ios.bundle_identifier_placeholder'.

layer.description: Which worker produced this finding. `store` is the pre-publish readiness worker (Stage 4e); `backend` is the FastAPI/Python backend worker (Stage 4f).

category.description: User-visible dimension the finding affects. `publishing` items do NOT contribute to the perf score (separate verdict). `backend_perf`, `database`, `algorithms` DO contribute — they are server-side perf categories ported from the web pipeline.

severity.description: User-visible severity. Drives ranking and the CRITICAL/HIGH/LOW grouping in the report.

confidence.description: Worker's confidence that this is a real user-impacting issue at this site. Static heuristics often medium; measured device issues high. PUBLIC field — surfaces as part of report ranking.

title.description: Short human-readable title. Appears as the finding header in the report.

description.description: Why this matters in user-visible terms. Appears as the 'Impact' paragraph in the report.

evidence.description: Whatever the worker captured. Schema-free by design — different layers have different evidence shapes.

function.description: Enclosing function name; cited in report prose instead of line numbers.

line.description: Stored for evidence.json only; NEVER cited in the report body.

code_snippet.description: 3-line snippet centred on the cited location.

summary.description: One-line description of the fix approach.

diff.description: Unified diff if synthesis was able to generate a concrete code change.

related_finding_ids.description: Workers leave empty; synthesis populates when deduping across layers (e.g. a static finding + a device finding pointing at the same root cause).

verdict.description: INTERNAL — Pass A's classification. REAL hits go in the report; FP and UNCERTAIN do not (per references.md Rule 1.8).

verification_method.description: INTERNAL — one-line explanation of how Pass A arrived at the verdict. Logged in decisions.log. Never surfaces in the report.
